name: Cabinet rig sink double door

parts.name: body
parts.massBasis: Hollow 18 mm MDF/particleboard box (5 panels) with stainless-steel sink basin on top. Shell panels dominate mass; sink adds ~4 kg near top-centre, shifting CoM slightly up and back. Variance factors reflect thin-panel distribution concentrated near outer faces rather than a solid block.
